title: The toolbar stays visible and interactive in the empty state
custom_preconds: 1. The report is showing its empty state (no matching invoices).
custom_steps:
1. Look at the toolbar.
2. Change the date range to a period WITH activity.
custom_expected:
1. In the empty state, the toolbar — the filters, the column selector, and the ⋯ exports — stays visible and interactive.
2. Widening the date range from the empty state re-fetches and renders the matching reps normally.
